title: I Built a Mulgore Inspired Zone using AI
author: Izkimar
selftext:
What you're seeing here is a side project I spun up a little over a day ago and have been building in parallel to a lot of other projects. 

In that short window I was able to build a full zone inspired by Mulgore, the Tauren starting area in World of Warcraft. Target-based combat, fully functioning quests with rewards, XP, abilities, animations, multiplayer networking - a solid chunk of the starting building blocks you'd need for an MMO-style project.  
  
All of this was built using [spawn.co](http://spawn.co), an AI gamedev platform for building web-based games.

comments.author: Slackluster
comments.body: Very cool, it will be interesting to see what you can do with a weeks of polish. Good idea to focus on just one zone. Did you use AI for the models and textures also? Did you use an editor or does AI generate it? Also a boss fight would be cool to see.

replies.author: Izkimar
replies.body:
Thank you!!

Yes, AI produced all of the assets on the spawn platform using their CDN. Which pulls to various API's such as meshy etc. 

I did do some prompting externally to get some nanobanana image refs to help with char models and such. And yes, I want to add some boss fights for sure!

replies.author: Slackluster
replies.body: Damn that's wild. Game dev is changing for sure. I am trying some similar things and have been very impressed. I think something people underestimate is how much co creation is needed though. AI will do what it is told but you still need to know what to tell it and how to debug and stuff. Looking forward to your update after you spend more time working on it.

replies.author: Izkimar
replies.body:
It really is, I think it's goin to be really insane a year from now. 

Yep there is still a lot of co-creation needed to make things good. Thanks again! Will continue to update.

comments.author: SkulkAndLeashGameCo
comments.body: Is this an ad for spawn.co? I don’t care either way, just curious. Looking at it now (on mobile so very limited) and cant find anything about pricing?

replies.author: Izkimar
replies.body:
It's not a paid ad no. But I am trying to get more attention to the platform and my own personal projects I'm building on there.

Mobile support is going to get a lot better soon. There is no pricing right now. Their goal is for creators to build for free and to monetize players instead.

replies.author: SkulkAndLeashGameCo
replies.body: Interesting! I joined the discord and will be checking it out today 😄
